<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/components/hero-split-parts.ts -->
<!--
  What HeroSplit shows beside the text: a picture, a picture with a floating card, a grid of four pictures with
  captions, or a picture with two plan cards floating over it.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { HeroContent } from "../blocks/hero-split.types";

  export type HeroSplitMediaProps = {
    content: HeroContent;
    alt: string;
    media?: "picture" | "card" | "grid" | "plans";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import OfferMedia from "../components/offer-media.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let { content, alt, media = "picture" }: HeroSplitMediaProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((media as string) === "picture")}
  <MediaFrame alt={alt} ratio="4/3" />
{/if}
{#if ((media as string) === "card")}
  <OfferMedia alt={alt} card={content.card} />
{/if}
{#if ((media as string) === "grid")}
  <Box class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4" data-testid="hero-grid">
    {#each content.features as f, i (f.id)}
      {#if (i < 4)}
        <Block tag="figure" class="flex flex-col gap-2" data-testid="hero-tile">
          <MediaFrame alt={f.title} ratio="1/1" />
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {f.title}
          </Text>
        </Block>
      {/if}
    {/each}
  </Box>
{/if}
{#if ((media as string) === "plans")}
  <Box class="relative" data-testid="hero-media">
    <MediaFrame alt={alt} ratio="4/3" />
    {#each content.plans as p, i (p.id)}
      {#if (i < 2)}
        <Stack
          gap="2"
          class={cn(
            "absolute w-48 rounded bg-card p-4 shadow-lg",
            ((i === 0) ? "top-8 left-4" : "right-4 bottom-8")
          )}
          data-testid="hero-plan"
        >
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {p.name}
          </Text>
          <Group gap="2" align="center">
            <LucideIcon name="check" size={16} />
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {p.tagline}
            </Text>
          </Group>
        </Stack>
      {/if}
    {/each}
  </Box>
{/if}
